description:
Multi-sensor Earth observation data cubes generated within the ARCEME project (Adaptation and Resilience to Climate Extremes and Multi-hazard Events). Each data cube covers a 10 × 10 km area centred on an extreme weather event site from the WOCAT / DHP database. Cubes integrate four satellite sources:

  • Sentinel-2 L2A – 13 multispectral bands + SCL scene classification
    (10 m / 20 m / 60 m, resampled to 10 m)
  • Sentinel-1 RTC – VV and VH SAR backscatter (10 m)
  • Copernicus DEM GLO-30 – digital elevation model (30 m, resampled to 10 m)
  • ESA WorldCover 2020 – land-cover map at 10 m

The temporal window spans 12 months before and after the recorded event date. Pixel resolution is 10 m; tile size is 1000 × 1000 pixels (10 × 10 km). Cloud masking is applied to Sentinel-2 data using the SEnSeIv2/SegFormerB2 model.
